remaining_risks: The original servpac.com/mtp-groundbreaking/ page is genuinely dead (HTTP 500 on repeated HEAD/GET with and without browser UA; no Wayback capture found). Replacement is a wire copy of the same company release, not the company's own page; content equivalence verified via search snippet. The whole servpac.com domain returned 500 from this environment, so the company's own site remains unverifiable at fix time.

actions[1] (2026-01-22 announcement) and actions[2] (2026-02-24 press-release mirror) now both cite the same PRNewswire URL; this is intentional and documented in the evidence_note, but a reviewer may flag it as a repeated URL across actions.
DCD article returns 403 from this environment (likely WAF) - it was not added; the entry's live corroboration rests on PRNewswire, HPR, and Building Industry Hawaii.
No other issues were listed for this center; status/evidence posture unchanged: Q2 2026 completion target remains company-reported and unverified.
summary: Fixed the single listed issue: the primary company source https://servpac.com/mtp-groundbreaking/ consistently returned HTTP 500, so the 2026-01-22 groundbreaking action's primary_url now points to the live PRNewswire mirror of the identical release, sources.refresh_2026_08_11 gained Hawai'i Public Radio as a corroborating source, and the swap is documented in data.json history and NOTES.md. data.json validated as valid JSON; no live reference to the dead URL remains, and the dead URL is retained as prose provenance only.
